title: WASM application release
description: The artifact an application publishes beside its build output and every host reads. v2 is a strict superset of v1: every v1 document validates, and the added fields describe what a host needs in order to prepare in the right order, budget the work, and know what activation means for this release.

release.description: Immutable release identifier. Never reused: a host refuses a release id it has already seen describing different assets.

runtime.description: How bytes become a running instance — the host execution contract.

framework.description: Which activation shape this release expects, when the runtime alone does not say. Leptos and Dioxus are both wasm-bindgen runtimes that activate differently.

toolchain.description: What produced the build, e.g. `wasm-bindgen 0.2.95 / leptos 0.7` or `flutter 3.35.1 (wasm)`.

requiresCrossOriginIsolation.description: True only for Flutter's multi-threaded renderer. Not a property of WebAssembly in general, and never applied fleet-wide by reflex.

prepareBudget.description: What a page is allowed to spend preparing this release before the visitor asks for it.

furthestStage.description: How far preparation may go. `compile` is optional and only useful where the runtime's init can accept a compiled module.

activation.description: What activation does once preparation is complete.

islands.description: Leptos: the island components this release hydrates.

routes.description: Dioxus: route path -> chunk asset id, as emitted by the framework's own splitter.

prepare.description: Whether this asset may be fetched speculatively at all. The v1 authority on preparability, kept as-is.

role.description: The part this file plays in startup. Lets a host prepare the variant a runtime will actually use instead of every variant.

stage.description: How eagerly a preparable asset may be taken. Absent means it is derived from `prepare`: true -> critical, false -> lazy.
